# Stone From the Landing

*The builders want stone from the quarry landing, and Lucan's crews won't go past the Reach without someone at the bow. Meet the barge at the stone wharf, clear the banks on the way, and tell Bennet the barge came home dry.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Lucan](../npcs/lucan.md) |
| Level | 40 |
| After | [A Barge That Must Sail](../quests/lucan_a_barge_that_must_sail.md) |

## Objectives

1. Reach the stone wharf in [The Quarry Landing](../maps/quarry_landing.md)
2. Defeat 40 [Bank Clang](../monsters/bank_clang.md) in [The Long Reach Banks](../maps/reach_banks.md)
3. Talk to [Bennet](../npcs/bennet.md)

## Rewards

- 12,670 EXP
- 800 mesos
- [White Potion](../items/white_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +150 standing with [Lucan](../npcs/lucan.md)
